nnye01.title: Aries: what I'm keeping
nnye01.caption: Being first isn't the problem, Aries. Rushing past people is. Leave the need to win every argument, keep the courage to go first, and let it be a little softer this year.

nnye02.title: Taurus: what I'm keeping
nnye02.caption: Some things get heavy because we carry them too long. Set down the old grudges, keep the loyalty that shows up, and let something new grow in the same steady ground.

nnye03.title: Gemini: what I'm keeping
nnye03.caption: All those drafts you never sent were trying to say something. Keep your curiosity, and this year point it at the conversation you usually change the subject on.

nnye04.title: Cancer: what I'm keeping
nnye04.caption: You take care of everyone so well that you forget to count yourself. Keep the open door, stop guessing what people feel, and save some of that warmth for you.

nnye05.title: Leo: what I'm keeping
nnye05.caption: You don't need applause to be worth loving, and you don't have to look fine all the time. Keep the big warm heart, and give it real rest between the bright moments.

nnye06.title: Virgo: what I'm keeping
nnye06.caption: Noticing the little things is a gift, until it turns into fixing people or replaying every word at night. Keep the noticing. Turn some of it toward yourself.
